Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 s_pending_units number(10);
begin
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is null THEN
 return;
 END IF;
 begin
 select count(*) into s_pending_units
 from holding_tests
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and temp_result_1 is null 
 and holding_status is null
 and test_id not in (select distinct test_id 
 from valid_band_results)
 and exists (select test_id from valid_tests
 where test_id = holding_tests.test_id
 and test_group not in
 (SELECT code FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 )
 ) 
 and exists (select tb_id from test_batch_det
 where tb_id = holding_tests.tb_id 
 
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and testing_lab_code = :s_testing_lab_code 
 and test_type = 'M');
 if s_pending_units = 0 then
 show_error('1233');
 end if;
 exception
 when FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE then
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in selecting from holding_tests');
 handle_error;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 v_con_int VARCHAR2(50);
 fac_con_int VARCHAR2(50);
 v_match VARCHAR2(1);
 v_match1 VARCHAR2(1); 
 n_match2 NUMBER:=0; 
 lv_local_chp_date DATE;
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 
Function IS_INT_EXT_SAME (p_unit_id in varchar2) return boolean is
 sCount NUMBER:=0;
begin
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into sCount from units where
 unit_id=p_unit_id and os_unit_id=p_unit_id and chapter_id=:GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 If sCount > 0 then 
 return (TRUE);
 Else
 return (FALSE);
 End If;
End IS_INT_EXT_SAME;
 
 
BEGIN
 
 nullchk;
 
 begin
 If IS_INT_EXT_SAME(:unit_id) then
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 AND INSERT_DATS = ( SELECT min(INSERT_DATS) 
 FROM units 
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id);
 Else
 select chapter_id
 into :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 AND chapter_id=:GLOBAL.chapter_id and rownum=1;
 End If;
 
 
--MLT# 218
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id := '';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0172');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id;
 
 --chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --Begin------------------MLT# 218A-----
 
 --- determine the contract ID
 
 lv_local_chp_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,SYSDATE);
 
 BEGIN
 select contract_id into v_con_int
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id;
 
 -- check if the UNITS table contract and the facility contract are the same (If not it is Renumbered)
 -- If it is renumbered the below sSQL will fail and go to the when no-data_found exception
 
 select contract_id into fac_con_int
 from valid_collection_agencies
 where contract_id=v_con_int
 and coll_id = SUBSTR(:unit_id, 1, 5)
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date + 1)
 AND rownum=1; 
 
 
 
 --message(:GLOBAL.unit_chapter_id||' con='||v_con_int);pause;
 
 IF v_con_int = 'INTERNAL' and LENGTH(:unit_id) = 13 then
 
 begin
 /*select 'X' into v_match
 from valid_collection_agencies
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_id = SUBSTR(:unit_id, 1, 5)
 and contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date + 1);*/
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from valid_collection_agencies 
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_id = SUBSTR(:unit_id, 1, 5)
 and contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date + 1);
 
 
 if nCount > 0 then
 null;
 else
 show_error('1230','- COLL ID and Chapter do not match');
 --message('COLL ID does not belong to the logged in chapter');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception 
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 ELSIF v_con_int = 'INTERNAL' and LENGTH(:unit_id) <> 13 then
 Begin
 select chapter_id into :global.unit_chapter_id from units
 where unit_id=:unit_id and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id; 
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1230','- COLL ID and Chapter do not match');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 show_error('1230','Reason-'||sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
 End; 
 ELSIF v_con_int <> 'INTERNAL' and LENGTH(:unit_id) = 13 then 
 begin
 /*select 'X' into v_match1
 from valid_collection_agencies
 where contract_id = v_con_int
 and coll_id = SUBSTR(:unit_id, 1, 5)
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date + 1)
 and rownum=1; */
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount
 from valid_collection_agencies
 where contract_id = v_con_int
 and coll_id = SUBSTR(:unit_id, 1, 5)
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date + 1)
 and rownum=1; 
 
 If nCount > 0 and lab_common.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(v_con_int, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y' then 
 null;
 Else 
 select NVL(count(*),0) into n_match2
 from contracts 
 where contract_id = v_con_int
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and contract_type <> 'RG' 
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date + 1)
 and rownum = 1;
 
 If n_match2 > 0 then 
 null;
 Else
 show_error('1871');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; --- for the contract type <> RG 
 End If;
 end; 
 ELSIF v_con_int <> 'INTERNAL' and LENGTH(:unit_id) <> 13 then
 Begin
 select chapter_id into :global.unit_chapter_id from units
 where unit_id=:unit_id and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id; 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1871');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 show_error('1230',' Reason-'||sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
 End; 
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION
 -- If the unit is not checked in the system
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND then
 
 Begin
 select contract_id into v_con_int 
 from valid_collection_agencies
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_id = SUBSTR(:unit_id, 1, 5)
 and contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date+ 1);
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 begin
 select contract_id into v_con_int
 from valid_collection_agencies
 where coll_id = SUBSTR(:unit_id, 1, 5)
 AND lab_common.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
 AND lv_local_chp_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,lv_local_chp_date + 1)
 and contract_id <> 'INTERNAL' and rownum=1;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 If Length(:unit_id)> 7 then 
 show_error('1230','- COLL ID and Chapter do not match');
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 Null;
 End If;
 
 when others then
 message ('B. Could not get the Contract ID -'||sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 
 When others then
 message ('B1. Could not get the Contract ID -'||sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End; 

 -- WHEN OTHERS then
 -- null;
 -- raise form_trigger_failure;
 END; 
 
 
 --END-------------------------MLT# 218A
 IF :coll_date is null and nvl(:warn_flg,'N') != 'Y' THEN 
 show_error('9320');
 :warn_flg := 'Y';
 END IF;
 IF is_unit_duplicate THEN
 show_error('9307');
 ADD_UNIT_TO_GROUP;
 END IF;
 IF nvl(:pre_unit_val,'XNULLX') != :s_holding_tests.unit_id THEN
 :unit_changed := 'Y';
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_c number(3);
begin
 if :temp_result_1 is not null then
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_holding_tests.s_result_code_desc_1
 from valid_test_results, master_codes
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
 and result_status = :temp_result_1 
 and result_status = code 
 and ((plate_seq = 'I' and nvl(:s_antigen_flag,'N') = 'Y') or
 plate_seq = 'R' and nvl(:s_antigen_flag,'N') != 'Y')
 and code_type = 'RESUL' 
 and sysdate between master_codes.eff_date 
 and nvl(master_codes.term_date,sysdate+365) 
 and sysdate between valid_test_results.eff_date 
 and nvl(valid_test_results.term_date,sysdate+365)
 and nvl(auto_only,'N') != 'Y';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1201');
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_c from utrs
 where unit_id = :s_holding_tests.unit_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and result_status_1 is not null
 and cancel_flag is null
 and not exists 
 (select 'x' from utrs
 where unit_id = :s_holding_tests.unit_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and result_status_1 is null
 and cancel_flag is null) ;
 IF ((:ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is null and :ctrl_blk_1.auto_schedule = 'N') or
 :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is not null)
 and temp_c > 0 
 and nvl(:res_exist_flg,'N') = 'N'
 THEN
 show_error('9324');
 :res_exist_flg := 'Y';
 END IF;
 exception
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 end;
 else
 :s_holding_tests.s_result_code_desc_1 := null;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is not null THEN
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
END IF;
IF :system.cursor_record = 1 THEN
 return;
END IF;
IF :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is null THEN
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is null THEN
 clear_record;
 return;
 END IF;
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is not null and :s_holding_tests.s_unit_id is null THEN
 IF NVL(length(:s_holding_tests.unit_id), 0) = 13 THEN
 :s_holding_tests.s_unit_id := '&=' || :s_holding_tests.unit_id || '00';
 ELSE
 :s_holding_tests.s_unit_id := 'D' || :s_holding_tests.unit_id || 'D'; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF :system.cursor_record != 1 THEN
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is null THEN
 :tb_seq_no := null;
 END IF;
 up;
 END IF;
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is not null then
 go_item('s_holding_tests.temp_result_1');
 END IF;
ELSIF :system.cursor_record != 1 THEN
 previous_record;
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is not null THEN
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
END IF;
IF :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is null THEN
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is not null and :s_holding_tests.s_unit_id is null THEN
 IF NVL(length(:s_holding_tests.unit_id), 0) = 13 THEN
 :s_holding_tests.s_unit_id := '&=' || :s_holding_tests.unit_id || '00';
 ELSE
 :s_holding_tests.s_unit_id := 'D' || :s_holding_tests.unit_id || 'D'; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF (:ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is not null and :system.last_record != 'TRUE' ) OR
 (:ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is null and :s_holding_tests.unit_id is not null) 
THEN 
 down;
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is null THEN
 go_item('s_holding_tests.s_unit_id');
 END IF;
END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_PROC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE COMMIT_PROC IS
 test_id varchar2(10);
 cur_rec number(4) := :system.cursor_record;
 rg_id RecordGroup;
 gc_id1 GroupColumn;
 gc_id2 GroupColumn;
 found Boolean; 
 msg varchar2(2000); -- V09 (changed from 100 to 2000 chars)
 temp_ret varchar2(80); 

BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('S_HOLDING_TESTS');
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id is null THEN
 clear_record;
 END IF; 
 FIRST_RECORD;
 rg_id := FIND_GROUP('RES_CNT');
 IF not ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 delete_group(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := CREATE_GROUP('RES_CNT');
 gc_id1 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'RES',CHAR_COLUMN,10);
 gc_id2 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'CNT',NUMBER_COLUMN);
 loop 
 IF :s_holding_tests.temp_result_1 is not null THEN
 found := FALSE; 
 for i in 1.. GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id)
 loop 
 IF GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,i) = :s_holding_tests.temp_result_1 THEN
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i, GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i) + 1);
 found := TRUE;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF not found THEN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id),:s_holding_tests.temp_result_1);
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id),1);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -------------------------------
 ---AUTO SCHEDULE TESTS---------
 -------------------------------
 IF nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.auto_schedule,'N') = 'Y' 
 and :s_holding_tests.coll_date is not null
 and :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id is null 
 THEN
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from dual 
 where exists
 (select 'x' 
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :s_holding_tests.unit_id
 and nvl(coll_date,sysdate) = nvl(:s_holding_tests.coll_date,sysdate)
 and nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = nvl(:s_holding_tests.chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 and nvl(test_chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and cancel_flag is null 
 and result_status_1 is null);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 declare
 temp_utr_max_seq_no number(4);
 begin 
 begin 
 select max(test_seq_no) 
 into temp_utr_max_seq_no
 from utrs 
 where unit_id = :s_holding_tests.unit_id 
 and nvl(test_chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and nvl(coll_date,sysdate) = nvl(:s_holding_tests.coll_date,sysdate)
 and nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = 
 nvl(:s_holding_tests.chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 insert into utrs
 (unit_id, coll_date,
 chapter_id, test_id, test_seq_no,
 program_id, insert_dats,
 insert_user_id, test_mode, 
 test_chapter_id)
 values
 (:s_holding_tests.unit_id, :s_holding_tests.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_1.test_id,
 nvl(temp_utr_max_seq_no,0) + 1,
 :banner.prog_name, sysdate,
 :banner.user_id, 'M', :GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in inserting in utrs');
 handle_error;
 end;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 end loop;
 go_record(cur_rec);
 msg := 'Results Entered - ';
 for i in 1..GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id)
 loop
 msg := msg || to_char(GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i)) || ':';
 msg := msg || GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,i) || '; ';
 end loop;
 show_error('9200',msg);
 savepoint A;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 IF :CTRL_BLK_1.tb_id is null THEN
 GENERATE_TB_ID;
 show_error('9300',' Note Test Batch ID: ' || :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id); 
 insert into test_batch_hdr
 (tb_id, test_chapter_id, user_id,
 insert_dats, first_unit_id)
 values
 (:ctrl_blk_1.tb_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :banner.user_id,
 sysdate, :s_holding_tests.unit_id);
 insert into test_batch_det
 (TB_ID, TEST_CHAPTER_ID, TEST_ID, 
 TEST_KIT_ID, TEST_TYPE, TESTING_LAB_CODE)
 values
 (:ctrl_blk_1.tb_id, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_1.test_id, 
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_kit_id, 'M',:s_testing_lab_code);
 begin
 temp_ret := sbclib.insert_test_parms(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, 
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_id, 
 :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id, 
 'MAN',
 :banner.prog_name);
 IF nvl(temp_ret,'null') != '0' and
 temp_ret not like ('No parameters defined for test')
 THEN 
 go_block('s_holding_tests');
 show_error('3106',temp_ret);
 END IF;
 
 exception
 when form_trigger_failure
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('1.1');
 go_block('s_holding_tests');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 ELSE
 update test_batch_det set test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_kit_id
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and test_kit_id is null;
 END IF;
 :system.message_level := 20;
 post;

 IF nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.no_of_tech,2) = 1 THEN
 MOVE_RESULTS;
 END IF;
 commit_form;
 IF not FORM_SUCCESS THEN
 rollback to A;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 message('Error in COMMIT');
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0000') ;
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM'); 
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_UNIT_DUPLICATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION IS_UNIT_DUPLICATE RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 rg_id RecordGroup;
 gc_id1 GroupColumn;
 gc_id2 GroupColumn;
 no_of_rows number(4);
BEGIN
 rg_id := Find_Group('UNITS');
 IF ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 CREATE_UNIT_GROUP;
 RETURN FALSE;
 ELSE 
 no_of_rows := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id);
 for i in 1 .. no_of_rows
 loop
 IF :s_holding_tests.unit_id = GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('UNITS.UNIT_ID',i) THEN
 IF :system.cursor_record != GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('UNITS.ROWNUM',i) THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF :system.cursor_record > no_of_rows THEN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 END IF; 
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('UNITS.ROWNUM',:system.cursor_record,:system.cursor_record);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('UNITS.UNIT_ID',:system.cursor_record,:s_holding_tests.unit_id); 
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF; 
RETURN NULL; END;

 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('UNITS.UNIT_ID',:system.cursor_record,:s_holding_tests.unit_id); 
 END IF; 
END;
